text:
Maya Chen: Quick check — HelioHealth preview cohort usage spiked on day 2 but dropped to almost zero. Can someone confirm seat assignments and whether we ran the onboarding workshop?
Omar Patel: I pulled their seats last night — 12 total, 7 active users, 5 invited but not logged in. I don't see an onboarding booking in Calendar past the initial kickoff. Link to roster: https://app.redwood/rosters/heliohealth
Jin Park: I ran the enablement webinar last week for HelioHealth, but it was a product demo not the hands-on workshop. Attendees list in notes, but only 4 did the lab exercise.
Priya Rao: That's the risk — low lab completion correlates with churn in similar cohorts. We should schedule 1:1 labs. I can run two 45m sessions next Tues/Wed morning PT. Who can support technical Qs?
Maya Chen: @Jin can you handle the tech deep dive? I'll take the product flows. @Priya please create the invite with pre-work checklist.
Jin Park: Yep, will prep a short troubleshooting doc and a quick KV-cache walkthrough. Snippet I'll share:
```
Pre-work: create sandbox org, upload sample dataset (<= 10MB), run sample inference request
Example curl:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"test"}'
```
Priya Rao: Added pre-work to the invite. Also created a short NPS + feature ask form for post-session feedback: https://forms.redwood/helio-feedback
CSM-Bot: Reminder set — 1:1 labs for HelioHealth scheduled Tue 10:00 PT and Wed 10:45 PT. Auto-cc: customer-success@redwood.com
Elaine Kowalski: Flagging renewal risk — their contract is up in 9 weeks. If lab completion < 60% after sessions, bump to Renewal risk-high and pull growth SDR.
Maya Chen: Agreed. Omar — can you pull usage cohorts post-lab (D+7, D+30)? Share in this thread. :eyes:
Omar Patel: On it, will post cohort metrics by EOD Friday.
Maya Chen: Thx team — capture any blockers in the HelioHealth playbook doc and tag #cs-risk for PM visibility.
